outcome_text: Families will no longer have to choose between paying rent and buying their kids school clothes.
Students will have the soap, deodorant and toothpaste they need each week.
Each participating student will receive a backpack filled with grade-level school supplies.
Children will feel dignity wearing clothes that fit them.
Students will come to class every day with their notebook, pencils and calculator.
We will distribute 1,200 winter coats to students at our partner schools this winter.
Every player on our teams will have the gear they need to play this season.
Every girl in our program will have access to free period products at school.
Every student we serve will have a warm winter coat and properly fitting shoes by December.
Our coat drive will put a warm coat on 1,200 kids this winter.
